info.title: KernelIndex API
info.description: Public read API over the KernelIndex catalog. Responses carry stable IDs, content digests, canonical units, and the ranking policy version; the web pages, CLI, and MCP render these same semantic results.

apiKey.description: Optional ki_-prefixed API key from /account. Public reads work without one; a key raises the quota and unlocks scoped writes.
